correctness_assessment.assessment: RequireLiveness uses local demand, whose AddLiveInput unions demand from consumers; dead retained definitions still retain dependencies. Exactly one lookup parent is required. Only live fetched IDs are kept and empty demand declines.

Replacement creates a distinct TOpRead using existing fetched definitions. The input Read and its private key IDs are never mutated, so other consumers retain their original read. CopyImpl creates fresh fetched/read IDs before this stage and preserves physical column labels.
correctness_assessment.invariant: Fresh read and shared input ownership

correctness_assessment.assessment: Plain TableLookup and Read both obtain per-column types through GetReadTableRowType, which uses loaded GetColumnType directly. Requiring IsSameAnnotation for each retained storage column preserves the resulting IU type, including optionality; IU aliases do not determine storage type.

Implementation metadata slots are explicitly index-aligned. Matching the implementation path to a ready ordinary synchronous index of the lookup main table plus complete ordered PK storage-name mapping supports one corresponding fetched row per index row. Async, specialized, unrelated, incomplete and reordered forms decline.
correctness_assessment.invariant: Metadata association and full primary keys

correctness_assessment.assessment: TableCallable, Limit, entire RangeInfo, SortDir and ReadSettings are retained. RangeInfo is copied by value while its expression pointers retain existing capture IDs; no new definitions or renaming is performed. OLAP and original predicate programs must be absent.

The sole registration is after pruning/copy/inlining and before CBO and stage assignment. Imported and copied Read/Lookup nodes start with empty physical properties. No earlier rule assigns Algorithm/OrderEnforcer, CBO join/shuffle choices occur later, and StageId is assigned later. Fresh empty physical properties are safe at this registered stage; they would require re-review if the rule is moved after physical decisions.

Successful rule application resets computed-property flags and restarts traversal. Required output IDs and parents are recomputed, liveness resets and propagates again, metadata/statistics are recalculated when requested. The new read carries no stale analysis/type metadata.

Queries with EnableQueryServiceSpilling enabled decline. This is conservative when effective channel spilling is disabled by another setting; it affects optimization reach only and does not weaken shared ownership guards.
